note: One entry per shot, in order. length: seconds in the final cut; a clip whose action runs longer is sped up to fit (at most 2x). caption: burned in and written to the .srt. voice: read by macOS say (spells the URL out). Every claim must be true of the app (check README.md).

shots.caption: Learning NEAR is hard. The docs assume you know crypto, and explainers are static. Book of NEAR lets you do the real thing.
shots.voice: Learning NEAR is hard. The docs assume you know crypto, and explainers are static. Book of NEAR lets you do the real thing.

shots.caption: A first visit starts with three questions. They pick your path: newcomer, crypto veteran or developer.
shots.voice: A first visit starts with three questions. They pick your path: newcomer, crypto veteran, or developer.

shots.caption: Demo mode simulates the chain in your browser, so you need no wallet. Build, sign and send a transaction, and watch it reach Final.
shots.voice: Demo mode simulates the chain in your browser, so you need no wallet. Build, sign and send a transaction, and watch it reach Final.

shots.caption: Give an app a key that can do only one thing. Then the app is hacked: the chain refuses each attack and says why.
shots.voice: Give an app a key that can do only one thing. Then the app is hacked. The chain refuses each attack, and says why.

shots.caption: Every lesson has a flat view and a 3D pop-up book. Follow a recorded testnet transaction hop by hop across shards, chunks and blocks.
shots.voice: Every lesson has a flat view and a 3D pop-up book. Here you follow a recorded testnet transaction, hop by hop, across shards, chunks and blocks.

shots.caption: Deploy a contract in one click, call it, then watch a cross-contract callback catch a failure.
shots.voice: Deploy a contract in one click, call it, then watch a cross-contract callback catch a failure.

shots.caption: Chain Signatures: one NEAR account signs for Ethereum. Derive an address, get a signature, and check it recovers to that address. In demo mode the app plays the signing network; the math is real.
shots.voice: With Chain Signatures, one NEAR account signs for Ethereum. Derive an address, get a signature, and check that it recovers to that address. In demo mode, the app plays the signing network. The math is real.

shots.caption: Ask for a cross-chain swap with an intent. In demo mode it is a recorded example quote, not a live price. No money moves.
shots.voice: Ask for a cross-chain swap with an intent. In demo mode, it is a recorded example quote, not a live price. No money moves.

shots.caption: Every lesson ends with an honest take on NEAR. Finish a stage to claim its badge: an NFT on testnet, kept in your browser in demo mode.
shots.voice: Every lesson ends with an honest take on NEAR. Finish a stage to claim its badge. On testnet it is an NFT. In demo mode it is kept in your browser.

shots.caption: Try it: book-of-near.pages.dev. Demo mode needs no wallet.
shots.voice: Try it at book of near dot pages dot dev. Demo mode needs no wallet.
